currentParagraphText: “I guess we’ll see,” Jake said as he used the Emblem. Artemis didn’t resist, and moments later, they found themselves standing across from one another within the familiar Colosseum of Mortals.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: They each stood behind their respective gates that had yet to be lowered. All the equipment one could ever want was available, and the two of them decided on just going with a bow each, along with the basic starting armor, which offered no real protection.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Yes,” Artemis said without a moment’s hesitation.
